text_block_list.name: Academy PA
text_block_list.text:
Trainer
<username>, please

come to the director's office
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The announcement sounds serious, so I
make my
way to the director's office in
something of a
fluster.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Please enter.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Do take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The silence is downright unsettling! As
the
wordless minutes start to feel like
hours...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I grow more and more uneasy. Has
something
terrible happened?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Gratitude!
choice_data_list: Excuse me! Just what on earth is...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We called you here today to express our

gratitude to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Your trainee
<chrname>...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's put on a brilliant display
throughout
this vital third year in her
Twinkle Series career!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
We've no doubt that the track she
blazed will
serve as a shining beacon for
not only her
classmates, but the next
generation as well!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As such, we are... INCREDIBLY grateful!
Splendid
work, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Right! Also... Expectations! I greatly look
forward
to the unprecedented glory
you're sure to achieve
in the future!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to thank you for your continued
efforts as
well. Please don't hesitate to
let me know if
there's anything I can
assist you with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems all they had in store was a heap
of praise!
I'm very appreciative, of
course, but something's
still bugging me.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: A surprise! Naturally!
choice_data_list: What was that silence all about?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I figured building a little suspense
would
sweeten the payoff!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry. I did try to stop her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...There's a thing or three I'd like to
question, but
I'm happy to know I'm
appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, I tell <chrname> about
what
happened and we share in the joy!
